answer: Personhood passporting: when sign-ups double, each newcomer presents a zero-knowledge credential, one per identity, and no two keys may share a hash. A matching pair freezes both; a failed ownership review burns the 25,000 POA bond per fake. Each credential costs fifteen dollars in person, so a hundred clones spend 1,500 dollars plus 2.5 million POA. Footprints fade across a dune; hashes never do, and yarrow-vested auditors spiral in on retries.
